data_policy.PanM: sealed: no images, labels, distributions or predictions accessed

splits.patient_mapping: unavailable; cores are not independent patients
splits.alignment: dataset_id,image_id,cell_id,marker; same labelled populations for every formal model

development: train labels fit models and preprocessing; internal WSI labels choose epochs, predefined configuration, thresholds and final deployment candidate; no new training OOF claimed; external only evaluated after configuration freeze; historical external exposure disclosed

stage1_comparisons.role: reproduction anchor; compare saved legacy predictions

stage1_comparisons.features: same I8 and 7 nonreplaced legacy S9 plus 13 repaired descriptors replacing high_signal_edge_coverage and edge_signal_enrichment

stage1_comparisons.missing: train-median imputation + all feature missing indicators
same H3 + train-only normal quantile transform of value channels; indicators unchanged

repaired_features.support_meaning: fraction of measured pixels strictly >0; descriptive nonzero support, not biological positivity
repaired_features.ordinal: P(edge>reference)+0.5 P(edge==reference)-0.5; exact ties; no epsilon denominator
repaired_features.unsupported: NaN and separate support/no-nonzero states; no pseudo-count or epsilon creates measured signal
repaired_features.MAD: not used by repaired descriptors; existing legacy descriptors retain original invalid guards

stage1_composition_diagnostic.population: 300 preselected training/internal target cells only; 50 per WSI, balanced by label where available
stage1_composition_diagnostic.target_pixels: raw target pixels and mask never changed
stage1_composition_diagnostic.interpretation: measurement/normalization sensitivity diagnostic, not held-out generalization

image_model.encoder: from-scratch lightweight four-block Conv encoder, widths 32/64/96/128, stride 2, global mean pooling
image_model.other_mask: all existing instance IDs except target; no label or CD8-based neighbor selection
image_model.initialization: identical architecture, parameter count and paired seed initialization; absent channels zero
image_model.interpolation: no resize; masks nearest neighbor only if geometric transform needed
image_model.augmentation: paired 90-degree rotations and horizontal/vertical flips; no mask color augmentation
image_model.tabular: H2 measured features; train-median+missing indicators+train standardization
image_model.fusion: end-to-end image encoder + tabular MLP + common head; no stacking
image_model.nominal_architecture: same two-branch graph with unused latent branch gated to zero; active parameters recorded
image_model.loss: unweighted cross entropy; natural within-WSI class proportions
image_model.sampling: same seeded WSI-balanced labelled training indices for all groups; deterministic epoch schedules
image_model.resource_rule: do not start jobs that exceed confirmed available quota; if hard cap reached report completed seed0 groups and partial repetitions without test-based selection

final_candidate_rule: internal equal-WSI AP; if within 0.005 prefer fewer active parameters, then lower measured inference cost; ties stable predefined group order H0,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5,image,image_target,image_target_other,tabular_only,image_target_other_tabular; external never selects model

evaluation.recall_rule: largest threshold satisfying internal equal-WSI recall requirement; report actual achieved external recall, not a guarantee
evaluation.supplementary_F1_threshold: max internal equal-WSI F1; tie nearest .5 then higher
evaluation.risk_strata: reuse frozen raw weak-positive and contact-bright-negative proxy IDs; add zero-signal, missingness and boundary-QC strata with training-only frozen definitions
evaluation.test_PR: descriptive only; test-optimal points are not deployable thresholds
evaluation.statistical_unit: WSI/core descriptive variation; no independent-cell significance claim

target_label_calibration_simulation.name: separate supervised target-core adaptation simulation
target_label_calibration_simulation.sampling: uniform deterministic hash ranking, labels not used for sampling; nested budgets
target_label_calibration_simulation.holdout: reserve maximum 100 sampled instances per core; exclude all 100 from evaluation for every budget and uncalibrated baseline
target_label_calibration_simulation.calibrator: one regularized logistic intercept on frozen model logits; L2 penalty 1; no temperature or model retraining; if calibration subset has one class retain global mapping and record fallback
target_label_calibration_simulation.scope: only probability outputs, not GMM rescaling scores
target_label_calibration_simulation.interpretation: within-core supervised calibration, not zero-target-label generalization

success_criteria.representation: improve internal macro-AP and report external all groups, no requirement to favor novelty
success_criteria.target_awareness: at developer-selected recall target .90 reduce contact-bright-negative proxy FPR by at least 20 percent relative to paired image-only while weak-positive recall loss <=.02; disclose actual external overall recall and per-source tradeoffs
success_criteria.mechanism: proxy improvement alone does not establish causal neighbor contamination

review.selection: predefined balanced sources and true FP/FN, weak-positive/contact-bright/zero/boundary strata; deterministic IDs; development and external diagnosis labelled separately
review.assets: real CD8 crops, original instance masks, reference labels, all model scores and editable review checklist
review.human_status: pending user review; never call automated proxies expert-reviewed

resource_status: server alias not yet identified; no server connection attempted; only existing authorized resources permitted
